# CARE Family Counselling & Children's Wellness Center

> Online counselling and wellness center based in Chennai, India, offering
> confidential, evidence-based mental health support for individuals,
> couples, families, and children — 100% online.

## Services
- Marriage & Relationship Counselling
- Couples Therapy
- Individual Counselling
- Child & Adolescent Counselling
- Family & Parental Counselling
- Stress, Anxiety & Depression Counselling
- Extra-Marital Affair Guidance
- Divorce Process Guidance
- Pre-Marital & Post-Marital Counselling
- Anger Management
- Work-Life Balance Coaching

## Team

- G Damodaran, MSc., PGDRP. — Child & Behavioural Counsellor
